results.title: Okanjuwa
results.overview: The romantic comedy follows Soluchi, a hopeless romantic still healing from being jilted by her former lover, Kalu. When a regular work call puts her in touch with the charming Eli, Soluchi begins to see the possibility of the love story she has always wanted.

results.title: Prisoners of Conscience
results.overview: Kaleidoscopic omnibus film with 11 documentaries about Georgian political prisoners: from animation and archive work to letters from the heroes and podcast with their friends.

results.title: Kings of the Beach
results.overview: A documentary about the epic rise (and subsequent fall) of beach volleyball, featuring many of the boldfaced names from Southern California who helped popularize it.

results.title: Yakuza Powered by Nihon Touitsu
results.original_title: 龍が如く Powered by 日本統一
results.overview: The first installment in the Yakuza/Like a Dragon franchise, which has shipped over 30 million copies worldwide, has been adapted into a live action work that remains almost faithful to the original. Produced by the cast and staff of the hugely popular franchise Unification of Japan, which depicts the Japanese underworld, the adaptation is fully supervised by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio. The story follows the events leading up to the video game Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties.

results.title: Video
results.overview: Video is a found footage, Docudrama by Srinidhi Bengaluru that stars Dheekshith Shetty, Bharatha, Jeevan Shivakumar, Tejesh S M, Priya J Achar, Nalme Nachiyar.

results.title: Qualcosa di Lilla
results.overview: The life of 15-year-old Nicole changes when Luce, who has suffered from bulimia since she was a child, joins her class. Consequently, Nicole also slides into the illness without realizing it. But above all, without anyone else noticing.

results.title: The Circle
results.overview: An investigator travels to a remote Moldavian village to examine a supposed hunting accident. As he talks to locals and reviews the events, inconsistencies emerge, leading him to question whether the death was truly accidental.

results.title: Wealwell's Guide to Reposed Standing
results.overview: Didn't attend Biffmore Academy? Fear not: Wealwell Gotch is here to impart his expertise.

results.title: Tougher
results.overview: After surviving prison and betrayal, a determined ex-con rises to power in Los Angeles' drug underworld - but when innocent blood is spilled, he must choose between protecting his empire or losing his soul.

results.title: Peace, Peace!
results.overview: An hour before their mother's funeral, three siblings are forced to reckon with the horrifying reality of their childhood.

results.title: Power: The Downfall of Huw Edwards
results.original_title: Power: The Downfall of Huw Edwards
results.overview: Docudrama following the downfall of BBC Presenter Huw Edwards.

results.title: Melanie Griffith - Die Frau, die Hollywood überlebte
results.original_title: Melanie Griffith - Die Frau, die Hollywood überlebte

results.title: See the Person
results.overview: The first film made in Bangladesh about Cerebral Palsy.

results.title: Box of Frogs
results.overview: Rob's lived with obsessive-compulsive disorder since he was a kid, and it's worn him down to the bone. He turns to a support group to reach out to others in similar situations.

results.title: Devil's Game
results.overview: When Michael's fiancée uses a Ouija board to manipulate his grief and create terrifying events, he must uncover her web of lies and deceit before her sinister game drives him to madness.

results.title: Hannah Berner: None of My Business
results.original_title: Hannah Berner: None of My Business
results.overview: Follows Hannah Berner as she questions her future, exposes her unorthodox career path, dishes dating secrets and admits she's "part-time hot."

results.title: The Last Act: Ediz Hun
results.overview: A biographical documentary that chronicles Ediz Hun’s 83-year journey—spanning cinema, academia, and theater—through his roles as an actor, ecologist, and collector, as well as his insatiable curiosity.

results.title: Shutterbug
results.overview: A rave photographer struggles to navigate a complex power dynamic with his boss, which comes to a head at an after party in Glasgow.

results.title: “Vaterland” or A Bule Named Yanto
results.overview: When German-Indonesian Yanto (mid 20s) visits his younger sister in Yogyakarta, he expects a simple reunion – until he realises she belongs more effortlessly than he ever has. As envy and dissonance between siblings surface, Yantos journey becomes a bittersweet exploration of mixed-race identity.
